reviewScope.summary: Test-only follow-up to A1 PR #52: replace a one-shot Playwright boundingBox assertion with bounded auto-retry; product commit 18d01baa6476cd918a0a2525a876b7733e8a600e. No application code, UI assertion geometry or release policy changed.
evidence: Original A1 hosted run 40981457967: 3,533 unit/integration tests and other pre-E2E gates passed; E2E stopped at rpg-primary-nav-layout.spec.ts, 768px bounding box null.

Failure screenshot and trace show the Open Settings link visibly present immediately before transient missing geometry; 1024px/1280px tests interrupted under fail-fast rather than independent layout failures.
Changed only the shared box() helper within e2e/rpg-primary-nav-layout.spec.ts. Polls real boundingBox at most five seconds and retains all geometry assertions unchanged.
Local Prettier, ESLint, TypeScript and three targeted Playwright layout tests at three workers passed before committing this review.
Pre-existing A1 eight-file implementation and previous review evidence retained. Owner accepts model-based review and no additional Codex/human owner review for small evidence-supported changes.
Full authoritative hosted Final candidate certification is still required for the exact new synthetic merge before any production change.

adversarialFindings.description: Raw boundingBox may return null for transiently remounted accessible elements despite correct stable layout.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Bounded expect.poll retries the same geometry lookup for at most five seconds; resulting x/y/size assertions remain unchanged.

adversarialFindings.description: A retry could mask a persistent missing navigation control.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Absent or persistently nonmeasurable control still fails the test after five seconds, and the ordinary full CI gate remains authoritative.

adversarialFindings.description: A locally passing three-worker focused test is not equivalent to comprehensive hosted certification.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Explicitly preserve full hosted certification; do not claim complete PASS until GitHub Final candidate passes.

retrospective.summary: Proportionate test reliability correction supported by actual failure screenshot, trace and targeted verification. Avoid suite-wide timeout increases, rerunning prior unit suites or weakening release safeguards.
